core: Augmont SPOT: electronic bullion trading and physical delivery for jewellers, bullion dealers and manufacturers
Augmont Gold For All: digital gold, coins and systematic gold savings for consumers

More than 49.62 million registered digital gold consumers, a large retail base for cross-selling
Integrated model across procurement, refining, trading and digital distribution

Grow international sales and enterprise membership

Growth in enterprise members and transaction volumes on the SPOT platform

Coal and iron ore loading, unloading and road transportation
Rake loading and rail coordination services
Caliber Mining & Logistics.revenue: Revenue comes from service contracts and work orders for mining, logistics and rake loading, billed on volumes handled or weighed quantity. Earnings depend on contract renewals, fleet utilisation and customer payment cycles.

Large owned equipment and fleet base
Long relationships with public sector coal customers

Operating leverage on a fixed fleet and equipment base

core: Recycled aluminium alloys in ingot and liquid form
Zinc alloy ingots and segregated furnace-ready scrap of stainless steel, copper, brass, lead and magnesium
Aluminium billets for automotive and non-automotive uses
CMR Green Technologies.revenue: Revenue is earned by converting scrap into alloys and supplying OEMs and tier-1 auto suppliers, with prices linked to metal markets plus a conversion margin. Volumes depend on automotive demand and scrap availability.

Liquid aluminium alloy supply to customers such as Honda Cars India, Bajaj Auto, Hero MotoCorp and Maruti Suzuki

Increase liquid metal supply to OEMs and tier-1 customers

Battery packs, sensors, electronic controllers, switches, terminals, connectors and power supply cords

EV adoption pace and policy support for electric two-wheelers
